[P1] Supply the new boto3 dependency in the Lambda layer

The publishing workflow builds its layer through `.github/scripts/build_lambda_layer.py`, which installs both wheels with `--no-deps`; this increased minimum therefore never reaches layer consumers. On a runtime whose bundled Lambda model lacks `XAmznTraceId`, enabling either OTel view now causes invoke START checkpoints to fail parameter validation instead of invoking the child. Updating wheel metadata alone does not upgrade that runtime client. Include the required boto3/botocore dependencies in the generated layer, and add an artifact-level regression covering deployment over an older runtime SDK.
